title: Uruguayan Bean Empanadas
description: A classic Uruguayan dish with a twist, these empanadas are filled with a delicious bean mixture and fried to perfection.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, mash the black beans using a fork or a potato masher.
Add the minced garlic, olive oil, and a pinch of salt to the bowl and mix well.
Open the package of empanadas and separate the pastries.
Place about 1 tablespoon of the bean mixture onto one half of each empanada pastry.
Fold the pastry in half to form a half-circle and press the edges to seal.
Heat the oil in the frying pan over medium-high heat.
Fry the empanadas for 2-3 minutes on each side or until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the empanadas from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
If you prefer a baked option, preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and bake empanadas for 12-15 minutes or until golden brown.
